sloka: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत ।न हि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य च ।। ७.२६.५२ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ tvamaparādhaṁ me kṣantumarhasi suvrata ।na hi tulyaṁ balaṁ saumya striyāśca puruṣasya ca ।। 7.26.52 ॥

translations.english: O virtuous and gentle one, you ought to forgive my offense, for indeed, the strength of a woman and a man is not equal.
